name: Agile Wealth Management
what_they_do: Private wealth management and financial planning firm for high-net-worth individuals and families, plus selected non-profits and institutions. Service model starts with a comprehensive financial plan, then a risk-targeted investment strategy, ongoing monitoring and review. The firm advertises independent, fee-only-style objectivity (says it sells no products) and a fiduciary standard, and describes a client-to-professional ratio under 25:1.
customers: High-net-worth individuals and families, multi-generational wealth transfer clients, and select non-profit/institutional organisations in central New Jersey.

size_signals.signal: One named professional, Arun Doddaghatta, as chief investment officer, 'supported by other members of our team'; Employees page lists no one else
Claims fewer than 25 clients per professional, and that it is privately held and sells no products
SEC Form ADV filing CRD #161254 lists 1555 Ruth Road Suite 6, North Brunswick NJ 08902 (filing dated 2012, so current registration unverified)

website_review.primary_cta: None - the phone and fax numbers in the header are plain text, with no call button, no form and no request-a-consultation path
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: None; the Contact page gives only a mailing address, phone, fax and a plain-text e-mail reference
website_review.trust_signals: Wealth-management philosophy, fiduciary and independence statements, an SEC ADV filing exists off-site; no testimonials, no client reviews, no team photos
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Copyright line reads 'Copyright © 0000 Agile Wealth Management' on every page; no viewport meta so phones get a zoomed-out desktop page; page titles are one word ('Firm', 'Contact Us', 'Employees'); the address zip is wrong ('08824' in the header, '00824' on the contact page, while the ADV filing says 08902); About page says 'CFA' while the Employees page still says 'CFA Charter Pending'
website_review.search_basics: Home title is just 'Agile Wealth Management' with no meta description and no town or service; section pages have one-word titles; 0 JSON-LD blocks; robots.txt returns an empty body
top_issues: No contact form and no click-to-call - the only path to the firm is copying a phone number or e-mail by hand
Broken copyright ('© 0000') and wrong ZIP code, which read as an abandoned or untrustworthy site
No mobile viewport: the site is unusable at 390px
No schema, no descriptive titles, no service pages for 'wealth management North Brunswick'

agent_readiness.notes: Findable: no Google Business Profile rating or reviews found at all; robots.txt returns an empty body so nothing is blocked, but there is no sitemap or structured data to help. Answerable: hours (Mon-Fri 9-6), address and a service description exist as real text, but the ZIP is wrong, the copyright is '0000', there is no schema and titles/descriptions are empty - a crawler has little it can trust. Bookable: nothing - no form, no booking, no click-to-call; an agent would have to hand the user a phone number copied from the page.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Replace the dead brochure site with a current one-pager: correct NAP details, working contact form, click-to-call, mobile layout and LocalBusiness/FinancialService schema
top_opportunities.evidence: No form and zero tel: links anywhere on the site, identical '© 0000' footer on every page, wrong ZIP, and no viewport meta at 390px

top_opportunities.opportunity: Create a consultation request path plus a compliance-safe intake (goals, investable assets range, risk tolerance) that routes to the CIO - currently none exists
top_opportunities.evidence: Contact page offers only mailing address, phone, fax; the firm says each client starts with a 'comprehensive financial plan' but there is no way to start one online

top_opportunities.opportunity: Claim a Google Business Profile and start collecting reviews; for a fiduciary practice with under 25 clients per professional, word-of-mouth currently has no digital footprint
top_opportunities.evidence: No Google rating or reviews surfaced in search; no testimonials on the site

scores.reasons: Gap: no form, no click-to-call, no viewport, no schema, broken copyright and wrong ZIP - the site is years out of date. Ability to pay: wealth management for high-net-worth clients is the highest ticket size in this batch. Ease: a small legacy site, but compliance review of any client-facing form adds a step. Evidence: opened home, about, employees and contact pages and read the ADV reference; review and listing data is thin.
